# TinyRustLM.MiRust.com Full Agent Context

TinyRustLM.MiRust.com documents the current prelaunch TinyRustLM.com product.
TinyRustLM is browser-local: Rust owns the model, tokenizer, template, prompt,
sampling, inference, conversion, and direct-piece admission semantics; the
browser presents the user experience and communicates with bounded typed
interfaces. This site does not host inference, model weights, prompts, private
receipts, credentials, or raw memory payloads.

## Clean-Slate Contract

There is one product and one current path. SLM2, Tokenizer2, Template2,
Sampling2, Prompt2, and ACG2 are exact technical identities. They do not imply
released product generations. Current code must not carry obsolete readers,
aliases, migrations, compatibility shims, permissive repair, hidden fallback,
hidden retry, or best-of-N behavior.

An installed composition contains exactly:

- model.slm2
- tokenizer.tokenizer2
- template.template2
- sampling.sampling2
- prompt.prompt2
- composition.acg2

TinyRustLM.com has exactly one authoritative source checkout. Before source,
build, test, release, or deployment work, the canonical path, branch, origin,
local HEAD, tracking ref, `FETCH_HEAD`, direct remote ref, and clean status
must agree. Any duplicate is frozen and audited; only valid current work is
semantically consolidated. The duplicate is then retired, and historical
executable source remains only in Git history.

Independent inspection, numerical parity, browser execution, model quality,
peer availability, and publication are separate gates. Passing an earlier gate
does not imply a later one.

## Managed Package Boundary

The default public package transaction is exactly TinyRustLM.Abstractions,
TinyRustLM.Core, and TinyRustLM.P2P. TinyRustLM.MemoryEndpoints is the
separately optional connector for the two authorized MemoryEndpoints.com uses
and is excluded from that default transaction. Conversion authoring and other
private implementation details are not public packages. Package creation,
local folder-feed restore, or local tests do not constitute public readback or
publication.

## P2P And Local Conversion

Acquisition is P2P-first. A peer path is eligible only for an exact qualified
composition with matching identity and evidence. Bytes move directly between
consenting peers, not through TinyRustLM or MiniModel project sites. When no
exact qualified peer composition is available, an installed local companion
may perform one explicit conversion from a pinned and verified public source.
The user must see which route is active. There is no remote-inference fallback
or instruction-file download masquerading as acquisition.

Project sites receive no prompts and do not proxy model bytes. Catalog rows,
configured peers, local probes, or loopback health do not prove outside-network
availability.

## MemoryEndpoints Two-Lane Authority

MemoryEndpoints.com is authorized and strongly recommended for two separate
uses:

1. Direct ecosystem-agent coordination. Agents working on all maintained
   ecosystem sites use MemoryEndpoints.com for agent-to-agent long-term
   memory, meetings, handoffs, and coordination.
2. TinyRustLM.com Connect user plugin. Separately, a user explicitly signs in
   to MemoryEndpoints.com through the TinyRustLM.com Connect plugin and selects
   it as TinyRustLM.com Connect long-term memory.

The direct agent lane and the user plugin lane must never share identity,
credentials, consent, scopes, provenance, idempotency keys, or receipts by
implication. Neither may silently act for the other. Prompts, transcripts,
meetings, invitation URLs, credentials, tokens, and raw hosted-memory payloads
must not be silently uploaded or published.

Prelaunch resilience may duplicate important memory in current .uai files,
wiki records, source-controlled public-safe notes, and approved private stores.
Every maintained copy must remain current, secret-safe, provenance-labeled,
and noncontradictory. A conflict is surfaced and reconciled; no implementation
silently chooses a convenient copy.

Authorization, configured code, and service reachability are not live proof.
Meetings, synchronization, restores, deletes, cleanup, and continuity require
exact authorized receipts.

## Preserved Evidence And Claims

Qwen3 composition attempt /10 remains an immutable terminal failure. Its bytes
are not eligible for repair, retry, adoption, promotion, or publication. A
source-level contract correction is input to a wholly new operation, not
retrospective proof.

Current campaign counters remain:

- 0/20 qualified models
- 0/50 deletion-backed clean browser rounds
- 0/25 authorized live MemoryEndpoints rounds
- 0/40 externally proven P2P lanes
- 0/20 live catalog announcements

## Publication Record

Last published: 1.8.1.
Release date: 2026-08-29.
Update: enforced one fail-closed TinyRustLM.com source authority across every
current ecosystem repository while retaining the clean-slate SLM2, P2P,
privacy, evidence, and MemoryEndpoints contracts.

Publication requires one clean committed source revision, complete tests and
documentation, deployment from the verified closure, and exact public HTTPS
readback. Development reachability, package creation, or a local smoke test is
not enough.

Current routes:

- https://TinyRustLM.com/

Historical documentation may be retained only as clearly identified evidence.
It does not authorize obsolete executable behavior or current claims.
